acceptanceCriteria: A documented rule for bumping the extension/integration package versions, tied to Corvint releases or STA-V0-001 manifest changes, and a check that enforces it.
body: protocol/integrations/speckit/corvint/extension.yml ships version 0.1.0 (V1-1696) with no policy for when it bumps, how it relates to Corvint releases, or how adopters learn of updates; requires.tools pins no Corvint version. Decide a host-package versioning rule.
title: Version and release policy for the Spec Kit extension and OpenSpec integration packages
